Features and Deployment

Production-ready deployment, Vercel integration, MCP servers, and thefull skill ecosystem for enterprise-grade Claude Code applications.

Core Features

The complete learning system with interface-first design, token-optimizedoutput, and modern UI patterns built with shadcn-ui and Tailwind CSS 4.0.

Vercel Deployment

Deploy your Claude Code projects to Vercel with a single click. Set upcustom domains, environment variables, and automatic CI/CD pipelines.Every branch gets a preview URL for testing and review.

MCP Servers

Configure Model Context Protocol servers for agent communication,shared context buffers, and distributed task processing acrossmultiple Claude Code instances with proper authentication and routing.

Skills Ecosystem

Publish, discover, and install skills from the Claude Code skillregistry. Manage skill dependencies and version compatibility acrossagent ecosystems with the rtk skill management system.

Advanced Features

Master the infrastructure that powers production Claude Code applications:custom hooks, loop design patterns, MCP server configuration, ECC(Evolving Code Craft) skills, security best practices, and outputverification.

Token Optimization

Track token savings with rtk gain, execute raw commands with rtkproxy, and apply token-saving patterns throughout your Claude Codeworkflow to reduce output by up to 90%.
